title: Surrender a motor vehicle tradesperson certificate
summary: Learn how to notify NSW Fair Trading if you no longer wish to keep your motor vehicle tradesperson certificate.
intro:
If you do not want to keep your motor vehicle tradesperson certificate you need to notify NSW Fair Trading.

To check your certificate number and details visit Verify NSW.

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit it:

more_info.text: Visit NSW Fair Trading for information about the Motor vehicle tradesperson certificate.

faqs.q: How do I check my certificate number and details?
faqs.a: You can check your certificate number and details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: Where do I submit the form to surrender my certificate?
faqs.a: You can submit the completed form at the Service NSW Centre.
